title:
One click.
A different pace.
voice: Meet Hertz Switcher. Change your refresh rate in a click, right from your Windows tray.

title:
Find your
flow state.
voice: Choose a preset for gaming, work, or winding down. Or switch instantly with a shortcut.

title:
Every app.
Its own rhythm.
voice: Set a refresh rate for each app, and let your screen adapt as you switch tasks.

title:
Set the mood.
Keep the focus.
voice: Adjust brightness without digging through menus. Choose the display you want to control.

title:
Step away.
Ease down.
voice: Step away, and the power saver lowers the refresh rate. Return, and your previous setting comes back.

title:
Keep what
matters on top.
voice: Keep what matters in view. Enable Always on top, then right click a window's title bar to pin it.

title:
Your screen.
Your rules.
voice: Hertz Switcher. Your screen. Your rules. Get it on GitHub.
